title: EEVblog #760 - Pebble Time Smartwatch Torture Test!

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: the 2015 Tough Bloke competition

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: I've got the new Pebble Time smartwatch

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: That's a Timex 1440

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: we're going to beat the crap out of it in the Tough Bloke challenge

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: about 8km of mud and crap and obstacles, 27 obstacles total

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: 30 metres water resistant

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: It's got a one-piece enclosure with a glued-on front face

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: he's got his Hero 4

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: if you get it at the right angle to the sun, it really is quite bright

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: you get away from the sun and well, yeah, it's not that terrific

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: I'm going to be using the stopwatch

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: I'll end up pushing the buttons on the obstacles

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: does this thing have any fitness tracking stuff?

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: it doesn't have a heart rate sensor though

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: let's put it underwater

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: My camera just fell in the mud

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: I think it's still on

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: The record button on my camera is stuck on

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: I don't think I dare press the buttons

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: Let's see if the stopwatch still works

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: No, the button doesn't work

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: we're going to take off the RFID timing tag

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: a bit of gunk down in the gold pins

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: skin and oil and crap just from the regular used

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: it survived relatively intact

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: Freezing cold water as well. And not a problem

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: Now it's tear down time
